Data.purpose: Produire l’aide et la documentation à partir de sources canoniques, en séparant le texte public éditorial des détails techniques générés.

help_resolution.no_duplicate_rule: Technical facts are referenced and generated, never copied into public help entries.

rules: Public documentation uses non-technical language and remains visible in Dev mode.
Dev documentation extends public help instead of replacing it.
A missing public editorial entry may use a safe fallback but must be reported by governance tooling.
Generated technical documentation must always resolve back to canonical metadata, schemas and registries.
Automatic versus forced values are shown in Dev diagnostics from the value-resolution contract.
Backend information is shown from the data-access contract without exposing secrets or SQL internals.
A help override can add explanation but cannot redefine version, dependencies, schema, source path or provider facts.
Canonical paths are resolved from framework-manifest.json and are not repeated in documentation definitions.

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Le système d’aide inclut désormais la résolution automatique/manuelle et le backend de données dans la surcouche Dev.
